display_name: Taxonomy KPI & Green Asset Ratio Aggregator
purpose: Rolls activity-level Taxonomy alignment (from ART-73) into entity KPIs: revenue/CapEx/OpEx aligned proportions and, for financial undertakings, the Green Asset Ratio (GAR) per the Disclosures Delegated Act denominator rules.
